notes.title: MAJOR RELEASE UPDATE - Build 1.0.116.106
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/f357cb00db4f6f7950652f74c68b6384a211c16c.jpg[/img]

[h1]MAJOR RELEASE UPDATE - Build 1.0.1.0.116.106[/h1]

[h3]Here we are guys!

Hello, Riders! 👋
We are happy to announce the new update of TrackdayR! Freestyle is now on TrackDayR! Get ready to break all your bones with you new arenas you will find in this update!
Can you pull off the most spectacular trick? record the replay and post it on social by tagging us!

[/h3]



[h1]BETTER PERFORMANCES[/h1]

This upcoming update will bring significant optimizations by using the CPU more efficiently. Heavier calculations will be offloaded and distributed across additional threads, which will enhance system fluidity and responsiveness. Users can expect a faster, smoother, and more stable experience overall, improving overall performance in everyday tasks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/6b2c11844b6326312db2f94c4b58f6227e527429.jpg[/img]

[h1]HOW TRICKS WORKS[/h1]

The trick management has changed, now to trigger them you have to perform combos with the right stick while ALWAYS holding down the LB button. Be careful not to be too daring with the combinations of tricks in the air and try to have them completed before you land otherwise what you will collect are only broken bones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/1eb56f4710a367937f2a8c846d35e09eee162d24.png[/img]

[h1]NEW TRACKS - FMX ARENAS[/h1]

Take on the new FMX arenas! Defy gravity in the T- Games Stadium, featuring three ramps and a massive airbag landing, perfect for safely pushing your tricks to the limit. Or showcase your skills in the iconic T-Fhighter, a historic Spanish bullring transformed into a freestyle paradise with ramps and quarterpipes for breathtaking stunts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/5b21079b2191144d4673260f25b64f78ffcf2872.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/10a037d4ea261f50fcaa3ff9856643aefcaf2698.png[/img]

[h1]FMX TRICKS[/h1]

Get ready to defy gravity with the new Freestyle Motocross (FMX) mode! Pull off breathtaking tricks, master the ramps, and take your style to the next level by perfecting your stunts with incredible maneuvers. Hit the track and prove who the real king of freestyle is!

[previewyoutube=Z7K6mCY0TlE;full][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/fc1ddf894ef473ff2dd074f9c134cb3106400765.png[/img]
[/previewyoutube]

[h1]KINEMATIC STEERING[/h1]

Kinematic steering refers to the study of the motion of a motorcycle, specifically how the geometry of the motorcycle affects its dynamic behavior. This study is important in understanding how a motorcycle's stability and maneuverability are affected by its geometric characteristics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/8a390780bc8e906fe89bbaa204729e666e7baa0e.jpg[/img]

[h1]RE-WORKED HELL OF SAND TRACK[/h1]

A completely reworked Hell of Sand layout ready to grind lot of laps and reach the top of the leaderboards or beat your friends on multiplayer races!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/f0a566ecf2e9e314a52ddbf226bd561f13086658.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and valuable suggestions. Keep sending us your feedback, and see you on the track! 🏆

[h1]MAJOR RELEASE UPDATE - Build 1.0.1.0.115.37[/h1]

[h3]Here we are guys!

Hello, Riders! 👋
We are happy to announce the new update of TrackdayR! We have been working hard to improve the game experience by listening to your feedback.
It was crucial to collect during these weeks every opinion we received from every social, constructive criticism is always welcome and allowed us to work hard on the goal.
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/ed0a21e2182d7b18bab07c1f7559b659ce07d2d3.png[/img]


[h1]RE-WORKED AIR PHYSICS[/h1]

We have refined the physics in the air to give you unprecedented control during whip and scrub! Now you'll be able to perform spectacular maneuvers with incredible fluidity, showing off your unique style as you fly over jumps. Get ready to dominate the air!

[previewyoutube=_xsRAea9uSo;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=1rd0hcW8VuA;full][/previewyoutube]

A compound made on the grounds of Uncle Luke's farm. A very compact red dirt track consisting of many varieties of jumps and very high banks. the layout is designed specifically for training and becoming familiar with whips and scrubs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/801307c8ac708368063c904866321e0acef2e6ed.png[/img]

[h1]BUGFIX HANDLING[/h1]

Driving on the ground is now smoother and more accurate! We've fixed some bugs that could affect the experience, ensuring that every turn and straight is even more engaging. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/fc1ddf894ef473ff2dd074f9c134cb3106400765.png[/img]

We have corrected some problems with the braking system of road bikes, making it more realistic and true to the performance of real bikes. Now you can brake even more accurately at decisive moments! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/6cc88564eb48d05198c2af0e1c1624c4189a34ce.png[/img]

[h1]ENGINE SOUNDS BUGFIX[/h1]

The roar of the motorcycles is crucial for immersion, and now it's even more accurate! We've fixed bugs related to engine sound, ensuring audio is perfectly synchronized with your performance on the track.

Christmas is coming so it's time to drop the last big update of the year! We hope you have a wonderful family holiday! see you on the TrackDayR tracks! OH OH OOOH! !
[/h3]

[h1]DOWNHILL[/h1]

Downhill has landed on TrackDayR! An extreme experience that tests reflexes and riding precision on steep downhills. Players face winding roads, dizzying inclines and breathtaking jumps. This update delivers pure adrenaline and authentic thrills, pushing the limits of simulation and fun, increasing competitiveness and strengthening the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/e2ed7e3fccf923e346871552c20bd253ed5b1443.png[/img]


[h1]NEW DH-001 BIKE[/h1]

The DH-OO1 is our first Downhill bike with state-of-the-art specifications. Ultra-light composite fiber frame, 210mm travel rear suspension, 200mm+ diameter disc brakes, and featherweight 18kg for the entire bike make it the perfect weapon for the most challenging descents you'll find.
It will be available in 4 colors: Yellow, White, Acid Colourful and Grey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/8a6196c67149996accbca582d85afccccd750ec1.png[/img]

MADLINE is our first track created for real enthusiasts and to give you a taste of where we can go with TrackDayR. Will you dare to set the best time in TimeAttack while also doing some bacflip or frontflip during the run?

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/3c1985477f2f20ae59e887d277e6c9095777ed9c.png[/img]

[h1]MAJOR RELEASE UPDATE - Build 1.0.112.51[/h1]

[h3]Here we are guys!

The time has finally come to drop the update!
[/h3]

[h1]TOURNAMENTS GAME MODE[/h1]

The Tournaments game mode will complement the TimeAttack one but will introduce virtual credits, which can be spent to be eligible for any tournament you want. The fastest player in each tournament will earn the most credits, but prizes will still be given throughout the top 10.Are you going to be the new King of TrackDayR tournaments?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528932/698c13226287bffbb821364796fedf10c1587cd4.png[/img]

[h1]NEW YAKUZA PROSTOCK DRAG BIKE[/h1]

Pro Stock drag racing motorcycles are designed for straight-line racing, with blistering acceleration over short distances. These bikes use powerful engines, producing between 350 and 400 horsepower. They are built to be lightweight and aerodynamic, with specialized tires for maximum traction and reinforced frames. They can reach speeds of over 300 km/h in just a few seconds.

- The new prediction code improves the accuracy of position determination by allowing more precise predictions, reducing the player's location error.
- The new lag compensation code improves the stability of connections, reducing the perceived lag during interaction. This allows for a smoother and more responsive experience, optimising real-time synchronisation, ideal for multiplayer applications or critical communications.

Somebody may have seen him delivering bread to old people or carrying bulky objects in Italian towns, but what a bore with a 50cc engine.

We are excited to announce that our development team has made significant improvements to the air physics of the motocross bikes in our game, TrackDayR. Thanks to these updates, our players can now enjoy even smoother and more responsive riding, making it easier to tackle the jumps and gaps on the cross track.

We focused on improving the aerodynamic stability of the bikes to ensure better maneuverability and agility. Our players have noticed a significant improvement in their gameplay experience, and are able to complete jumps and gaps with greater precision and ease.

We are very proud of the work we have done and believe that air physics is a crucial aspect of an engaging motocross gaming experience. We will continue to work hard to improve our simulation and provide our players with the best possible riding experience. Thank you for your continued support!
